_what: Judge settings of protocol v2.3 (Section 11.3), read by src/judge_v23.py and src/run_judges_v23.py. The provider configuration of each judge is its entry in config/models.json with these settings on top (judge_v23.judge_cfg). Changes after the pilot registration only by the rules of Section 13.3 (cap_doubled; the output-format mechanics of the template under rule 1) and decision D1 (d1_context_off, before the freeze).

local._output_cap_by_judge: Decision D24 (13 November 2026): models 16 and 17 write their reasoning into the output, so they have a cap of their own; measured on harmless sentinel pairs by scripts/measure_judge_reasoning_v23.py (results/logs/judge_reasoning_v23.json). Rule 3 of Section 13.3 doubles it once, as it doubles the common cap.
